description_en: Queries the access configurations that are provisioned
description_zh: 调用ListAccessConfigurationProvisionings查询访问配置部署列表
name: ListAccessConfigurationProvisionings

parameters.help_en: The ID of the access configuration. The ID can be used to filter access permissions
parameters.help_zh: 访问配置ID，用于查询的过滤条件
parameters.name: access_configuration_id

parameters.help_en:
The type of the task object. The type can be used to filter access permissions.

Set the value to RD-Account, which specifies the accounts in the resource directory.

You can use the type to filter access permissions only if you specify both `TargetId` and `TargetType`
parameters.help_zh:
任务目标类型，用于查询的过滤条件。

取值：RD-Account，表示任务目标类型为RD账号。

`TargetId`与`TargetType`必须同时配置才能作为有效的过滤条件进行查询
parameters.name: target_type

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the task object. The ID can be used to filter access permissions.

You can use the type to filter access permissions only if you specify both `TargetId` and `TargetType`
parameters.help_zh:
任务目标ID，用于查询的过滤条件。

`TargetId`与`TargetType`必须同时配置才能作为有效的过滤条件进行查询
parameters.name: target_id

parameters.help_en:
The status of the access configuration. The value can be used to filter accounts. Valid values:

Provisioned: The access configuration is provisioned.

ReprovisionRequired: The access configuration needs to be re-provisioned.

DeprovisionFailed: The access configuration failed to be provisioned
parameters.help_zh:
部署状态，用于查询的过滤条件。取值：

Provisioned：部署成功。
ReprovisionRequired：需要重新部署。
DeprovisionFailed：部署失败
parameters.name: provisioning_status

parameters.help_en:
The returned value of NextToken is a pagination token, which can be used in the next request to retrieve a new page of results. If this is your first time to call this operation, you do not need to specify the `NextToken` parameter.

When you call this operation for the first time, if the total number of entries to return exceeds the value of `MaxResults`, the entries are truncated. Only the entries that match the value of `MaxResults` are returned, and the excess entries are not returned. In this case, the value of the response parameter `IsTruncated` is `true`, and `NextToken` is returned. In the next call, you can use the value of `NextToken` and maintain the settings of the other request parameters to query the excess entries. You can repeat the call until the value of `IsTruncated` becomes `false`. This way, all entries are returned
parameters.help_zh:
查询返回结果下一页的令牌。首次调用API不需要`NextToken`。

当您首次调用API时，如果返回数据总条数超过`MaxResults`限制，数据会被截断，只返回`MaxResults`条数据，同时，返回参数`IsTruncated`为`true`，返回一个`NextToken`。您可以使用上一次返回的`NextToken`继续调用API，其他请求参数保持不变，查询被截断的数据。您可以按此方法多次查询，直到`IsTruncated`为`false`，表示全部数据查询完毕
parameters.name: next_token

parameters.help_en:
The maximum number of entries per page.

Valid values: 1 to 20.

Default value: 10
parameters.help_zh:
每页的最大数据条数。

取值范围：1~20。

默认值：10
parameters.name: max_results

AccessConfigurationProvisionings.description_en: The accounts for which the access configuration is provisioned

AccessConfigurationId.description_en: The ID of the access configuration

AccessConfigurationName.description_en: The name of the access configuration

CreateTime.description_en: The first time when the access configuration was provisioned
CreateTime.description_zh: 首次部署成功的时间。格式为 RFC 3339 的 UTC 时间（YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm:ssZ）

RAMPolicyNames.description_en: The name of the custom policy that is created for an account in the resource directory
RAMPolicyNames.description_zh: 在RD账号中创建的自定义策略名称

items.description_en:
The name of the custom policy that is created for an account in the resource directory.

This parameter is returned only if an inline policy is created for the access configuration
items.description_zh:
在RD账号中创建的自定义策略名称。

只有访问配置存在内置策略，才显示该参数

RAMRoleName.description_en: The name of the RAM role that is created for an account in the resource directory
RAMRoleName.description_zh: 在RD账号中创建的RAM角色名称

SAMLProviderName.description_en: The name of the Security Assertion Markup Language (SAML) identity provider (IdP) that is created within an account in the resource directory
SAMLProviderName.description_zh: 在RD账号中创建的SAML身份提供商名称

Status.description_en:
The status of the access configuration. Valid values:

Provisioned: The access configuration is provisioned.

ReprovisionRequired: The access configuration needs to be re-provisioned.

DeprovisionFailed: The access configuration failed to be provisioned
Status.description_zh:
部署状态。取值：

Provisioned：部署成功。
ReprovisionRequired：需要重新部署。
DeprovisionFailed：部署失败

TargetId.description_en:
The ID of the task object.

If the value of TargetType is `RD-Account`, the value of this parameter is the UID of an account in the resource directory
TargetId.description_zh:
任务目标ID。

当任务目标类型为`RD-Account`时，该参数为RD账号UID

TargetName.description_en: The name of the task object

TargetPath.description_en: The path ID of the task object in the resource directory
TargetPath.description_zh: 任务目标在资源目录中的路径ID

TargetPathName.description_en: The path name of the task object in the resource directory
TargetPathName.description_zh: 任务目标在资源目录中的路径名称

TargetType.description_en:
The type of the task object.

Set the value to RD-Account, which specifies the accounts in the resource directory
TargetType.description_zh:
任务目标类型。

取值：RD-Account，表示任务目标类型为RD账号

UpdateTime.description_en: The last time when the access configuration was provisioned
UpdateTime.description_zh: 最近一次部署成功的时间。格式为 RFC 3339 的 UTC 时间（YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm:ssZ）

IsTruncated.description_en:
Indicates whether the queried entries are truncated. Valid values:

true

false
IsTruncated.description_zh:
返回结果是否被截断。取值：

true：已截断。
false：未截断

MaxResults.description_en: The maximum number of entries returned per page

NextToken.description_en:
The returned value of NextToken is a pagination token, which can be used in the next request to retrieve a new page of results.

This parameter is returned only when the value of `IsTruncated` is `true`
NextToken.description_zh:
查询返回结果下一页的令牌。

只有`IsTruncated`为`true`，才显示该参数

TotalCounts.description_en: The total number of entries returned
TotalCounts.description_zh: 符合请求参数条件的数据总条数
